ns2:section.sectionText: 1ST EIGHT WEEKS: Registration for this course will close at 9 AM on the first day of instruction. No overrides will be given after that time. It may take 24 hours after registering for you to have access to the course on Canvas. This course provides students with foundational knowledge, strategies, and skills necessary to develop and maintain a healthy and physically active lifestyle. Students will engage in weekly, self-determined physical activity throughout the 8-weeks. This course attempts to provide students with strategies to establish and maintain healthy habits related to one’s personal physical activity.
